summary: Confine setup and Claude cleanup paths and preflight combined hook removal.

decisions.problem: R1/R2 cleanup escaped repository ownership and R4 combined cleanup mutated before validation.
decisions.choice: Use shared candidate-and-parent confinement and preflight all selected setup/cleanup targets before mutation.
decisions.rationale: Closes the reproduced external-link and predictable partial-cleanup failures while preserving custom content, linked roots, and existing Git-hook locality policy.

evidence.content: Setup subagent reported both real-junction back-link regressions failed the old helper, then passed after parent confinement; linked root remains accepted. Focused non-live setup: 103 passed, 9 actual WinError 1314 symlink skips, 8 live deselected in 24.69s. Full candidate suite restarted after repair; earlier interrupted run has no full-suite result.

Subagent-reported checks: setup 100 passed, 9 skipped, 8 deselected; all 18 real Windows junction cases passed. Skips: original external-directory symlink test and 8 external-file/dangling symlink cases, WinError 1314. Cleanup plus existing Git hooks 78 passed, no skips; 2 later invalid-parent cases passed separately. Tests use owned workspace temp to avoid default temporary-directory sandbox denial.

Final complete project suite: 377 passed, 9 skipped in 526.09s on Windows/Python3.12.14/MCP2.2.0. All MCP stdio and junction regressions executed. Skipped test_all_client_preflight_rejects_symlink_escaping_repository plus eight test_setup_rejects_external_legacy_file_symlink_before_writes parameters encountered actual WinError1314. Remedy Developer Mode/elevated shell. Earlier interrupted run and isolated passes are not counted.
